name: livebench-llm-benchmark
description: Livebench-llm-benchmark is a continuously updated Hugging Face dataset that aggregates real-world prompts and model responses to track and compare LLM performance over time. It covers a variety of tasks (question answering, instruction following, code) to evaluate models under realistic usage scenarios.
reputation: Community-maintained Hugging Face benchmark used for ongoing model comparisons; modest but growing adoption.
